green_literal_audit.scope: Color numeric literals, Color.GREEN/LIME, scene modulates, shader colors/parameters; source art reviewed and routed via shared ramps where relevant. Does not claim untouched source PNG pixels are recolored on disk.
green_literal_audit.reason: Four stage floor colors on two lines intentionally preserved by user requirement.

hostile_projectile_contrast: smoke_archetypes retains minimum 4.5:1 on all 12 stage floors; DANGER_PROJECTILE is bright red because base suggested red was too dark for small bullets.
mechanics: No balance or attack geometry changed. Shared stat helper extraction preserves formulas; smoke_palette_cards compares actual upgrades with preview values for all22 at character level7, additional heal/combo/fist checks, no RNG mutation; speed remains +20.

screenshots.grayscale: Browser CSS filter grayscale(1) on canvas; no image generation or repainting.

limitations: Known command-line ObjectDB/resource-in-use shutdown warnings are retained per check; runtime/script/build errors are not ignored.
No physical Safari/iOS/device-performance run. Chromium uses software WebGL2.
No full campaign, all-weather stress, entire smoke-suite or itch iframe verification.
Gray screenshots are a visual/layout check, not a guarantee for every player or every weather combination.
No release/upload or default-branch merge in this task.
